This first bail application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the applicant Mohd. Jakir S/o Mohd.
Siddique Khan for grant of regular bail, who has been arrested on 30.05.2024 in connection with Crime No.190/2024 registered at Police Station M.G. Road, District Indore (M.P.) for commission of offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 474, 120-B, 409 and 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860.

28.05.2024 to police station M.G. Road Indore regarding lodging an FIR against firms namely King Constructions, Green Constructions and Jahanvi Enterprises for preparation and presentation of four forged bills with regard to the work of trenching ground, Indore.

sentences.text: When NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6753 2 MCRC-10009-2025 the said bills were verified by concerned authorities, the same were found forged and fabricated.

Based on the said written compliant,
non-applicant No.1 registered the case against co-accused Mohd. Sajid, Mohd. Siddique, Renu Vadera, Rahul Vadera and present applicant Mohd. Jakir for forging bills of fake work and presented them in the concerned department of the Municipal Corporation and Rs.1,40,40,000/-
